## Gait Libraries: Hybrid-Zero Dynamics {.nav-approach}

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="50%"}
Utilize FROST to generate gait $X(\alpha)$ composed via Bézier polynomials.

Bézier polynomials are parametrized by *control points* $\alpha$.

Gait characteristics like *step width* are included in additional constraints.
:::

::: {.column width="50%" style="font-size: 0.8em;"}
\begin{align}
    \overbrace{X(\alpha)^*}^{\textrm{Joint Trajectories}} = ~&\underset{X(\alpha)}{\textrm{argmin}} ~\overbrace{\mathcal{J}(X(\alpha))}^{Cost} \notag \\
   \textrm{s.t.} & \quad \textrm{Closed Loop Dynamics} \\
    & \quad \textrm{Impact Invariance} \\
    & \quad \textrm{Physical Feasibility}  \\
    & \quad \textrm{Additional Constraints}
\end{align}
:::
